_meta.indication: Radioactive diagnostic agent indicated for lymphatic mapping with a hand-held gamma counter to assist in the localization of lymph nodes draining a primary tumor site in patients with breast cancer or melanoma.

pivotal_trials.design: Prospective, non-randomized, open-label, multicenter, single arm, within-patient comparison study of Tc 99m Lymphoseek (LS) and Blue Dye (BD) as lymphoid tissue targeting agents.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with primary melanoma or breast cancer; of 179 patients, 94 (52.5%) had breast cancer and 85 (47.5%) had melanoma; median age 59 years.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Nodal concordance of Lymphoseek considering blue dye as the "truth" comparator at the node level (# of BD+ and also LS+ nodes / # of BD+ nodes).
pivotal_trials.n: 179 patients received Lymphoseek (256 ITT nodes analyzed).

pivotal_trials.design: Prospective, non-randomized, open-label, multicenter, single arm, within-patient comparison study of Tc 99m Lymphoseek (LS) and Blue Dye (BD) as lymphoid tissue targeting agents.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with primary melanoma or breast cancer; of 153 patients, 77 (50.3%) had breast cancer and 76 (49.7%) had melanoma; median age 61 years.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Nodal concordance of Lymphoseek considering blue dye as the "truth" comparator at the node level.
pivotal_trials.n: 153 patients received Lymphoseek (229 ITT nodes analyzed).

key_safety: No serious adverse reactions among 542 patients in clinical trials; the most common adverse reactions were injection site irritation (3 of 542; 0.6%) and pain (1 of 542; 0.2%), each occurring in <1% of patients.
target_moa: Radioactive diagnostic agent that accumulates in lymphatic tissue and selectively binds to mannose binding receptors (CD206) on the surface of macrophages and dendritic cells; the mannose acts as a ligand for the receptor and the DTPA serves as a chelating agent for labeling with technetium Tc 99m.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for a drug of this class in the intended population.

description.text: Added use for guiding sentinel lymph node biopsy with hand-held gamma counter in patients with clinically node negative squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity

citations.quote: This "Prior Approval" supplemental new drug application provides for the use of Lymphoseek for guiding sentinel lymph node biopsy, using a hand-held gamma counter in patients with clinically node negative squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity.

description.text: Added guiding sentinel lymph node biopsy in patients with clinically node negative squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity, breast cancer or melanoma

citations.quote:
- Lymphatic mapping using a handheld gamma counter to locate lymph nodes draining a primary tumor site in patients with solid tumors for which this procedure is a component of intraoperative management.
- Guiding sentinel lymph node biopsy using a handheld gamma counter in patients with clinically node negative squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity, breast cancer or melanoma.

description.text: Extended the lymphatic mapping indication to pediatric patients age one month and older with solid tumors

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for required pediatric assessments efficacy supplement for PREA study 2789-1 and an extension of the indication of Lymphoseek with or without scintigraphic imaging for lymphatic mapping using a handheld gamma counter to locate lymph nodes draining a primary tumor site in adult and pediatric patients age one month and older with solid tumors for which this procedure is a component of intraoperative management.

summary.text: Lymphoseek was approved as a standard NDA under section 505(b) in a second review cycle after a prior Complete Response Letter over unresolved manufacturing facility inspection deficiencies; no advisory committee was convened and the pediatric study requirement was waived.

citations.quote: This is a second cycle review for Lymphoseek, a diagnostic radiopharmaceutical. The first cycle review was completed with resolution of all issues except for facility inspectional items.
Satisfactory resolution of these deficiencies is required before this application may be approved.
We are waiving the pediatric study requirement for this application because necessary studies are impossible or highly impracticable.

date.text: Complete Response Letter issued on the original NDA dated/received August 10, 2011

citations.quote: Please refer to your New Drug Application (NDA) dated August 10, 2011, received August 10, 2011, submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for Lymphoseek (technetium Tc 99m tilmanocept) Injection.

basis.text: Deficiencies conveyed during inspections of the manufacturing facilities; satisfactory resolution of these deficiencies was required before approval.

citations.quote: During recent inspections of the (b) (4) manufacturing facilities for this application, our field investigators conveyed deficiencies to the representatives of the facilities. Satisfactory resolution of these deficiencies is required before this application may be approved.
